name: batch-scheduler
description: Deterministic batch planner: read the live work graph and emit parallel-execution batches (order-respecting, collision-free) as the fixed `batch-plan@3` machine envelope — which issues can run together now, which are blocked and by what, which unit is really in flight, which pairs would rewrite the same file, which surface each lane occupies, what changed. Triggers: "batch scheduler", "what can run in parallel", "plan the batches", "batch plan".
